projects.title: Autonomous Solar Campus Rover
projects.description: Obstacle-avoiding campus surveillance rover with high-efficiency solar tracking, LoRa telemetry, and edge-AI visual detection for night patrolling.
projects.author: Rahul V & Team

projects.title: Smart Polytechnic Water Recycling Grid
projects.description: Automated lab graywater filtration and distribution system utilizing solenoid valves, ultrasonic flow sensors, and an ESP32 telemetry gateway.
projects.author: Arjun K & Fathima Riya

ideas.title: Automated Polytechnic Examination Paper Sorter
ideas.problemStatement: Manual sorting of 2000+ diploma examination papers consumes 15+ teacher hours each exam cycle.
ideas.proposedSolution: Optical barcode scanner and stepper-motor bin diverter powered by Raspberry Pi Pico.

ideas.title: Solar Powered EV Charging Station for Campus E-Bikes
ideas.problemStatement: Students commuting by electric scooters lack on-campus charging points.
ideas.proposedSolution: Off-grid 3kW solar canopy with smart RFID billing system for polytechnic students.

startups.name: AgriTech Automation Systems
startups.tagline: IoT Precision Irrigation for Malappuram Spice Plantations
startups.description: AI-driven low-cost solar irrigation controllers specifically calibrated for soil moisture levels in rubber and pepper plantations across Malappuram district.

resources.title: ESP32 Embedded Systems & RTOS Handbook
resources.description: Complete reference manual with schematics, FreeRTOS tasks, and WiFi server examples for diploma students.
resources.author: Prof. Muhammed Rashid

resources.title: Official IEDC Innovation Pitch Deck Template (PPTX)
resources.description: Standard 10-slide pitch presentation deck approved by Kerala Startup Mission for college incubator screening.
resources.author: IEDC GPTC PMNA

blogs.title: How IEDC GPTC PMNA Built an Award-Winning Solar Rover
blogs.excerpt: A behind-the-scenes journey of how diploma electronics students transformed raw scrap parts and microcontrollers into a state-winning rover.
blogs.content: Building an autonomous solar rover inside a polytechnic makerspace was both challenging and exhilarating. Our team of second and third-year students spent evenings in the ICFC lab experimenting with motor drivers, LoRa radio packets, and computer vision models...
blogs.author: Prof. Muhammed Rashid
